message.content: {"note_claim": "The video uses footage from Alaska exercises, not Greenland.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The Pacific Air Force's F-16 Viper Demonstration Team Preforms over Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, Alaska, during Arctic Thunder Open House, July 31, 2022.", "reason": "The DVIDS page confirms the video shows an F-16 demo team performing at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson in Anchorage, Alaska, directly substantiating the note's claim that the footage is from Alaska, not Greenland."}
